purpose: Fail-closed disposition of current V3 operational reviews after partial-label contradiction precedence was corrected. Decisions are bound to the exact current case/side review topology and do not alter resolver policy.

decisions.rationale: The official specification contains both GT and Dark Horse 5.0 V8 coupe configurations. Engine, generation and body style do not determine the missing variant.

The official Porsche evidence distinguishes Carrera variants. The operational observations remain insufficient to collapse either current review into an existing Carrera identity without stronger case-bound evidence.

The retained BMW reference distinguishes specific G20 configurations. The generic 3 Series observation does not establish 330i identity, and the partial 330i label observation remains review-bound against the existing catalog topology.
Toyota MY25 evidence contains multiple hybrid trims. Missing variant evidence cannot be deterministically assigned to XRX Hybrid.
Official Chevrolet MY25 material contains multiple Turbo 116cv automatic hatch configurations. Mechanical identity and model year do not uniquely prove Premier when variant is absent.
Official Volkswagen evidence contains more than one 250 TSI T-Cross trim. A generic 250 TSI observation cannot determine the missing variant.
FIPE lookup requires code plus model year under the curated semantics. The two current code-only observations lack model-year evidence and are insufficient for deterministic catalog identity.

The evidence establishes the Highline 250 TSI mechanical family and MY26 context but does not establish that the yearless observation itself is MY26. Senatran-aligned policy therefore preserves REVIEW for the current MY26-side observation.

Toyota explicitly establishes Altis Hybrid Premium in model year 2025 and Altis Premium Hybrid 26/26, but the operational candidates are older generic Corolla sedan canonicals with no model-year or variant evidence. Neither year-specific observation is established as the same catalog identity as those yearless generic canonicals. Auto-matching would infer missing model-year and variant dimensions, so both current case sides remain human review.
